acceptance.evidence: Default flat rename/skip planning remains unchanged; existing CLI, queue, ownership, manifest, log, launcher and characterization cases pass in clean Full on both hosts.

Repeated camera/scene clip names separate under stable roots; explicit-file parents, shallow ancestors, aliases, reversal, ordinal/culture independence, repeated and literal suffixed names, drive/UNC root labels and Unicode paths. Actual PS1/BAT synthetic native conversions and installed FFmpeg nested media pass on both hosts.

Every nominal/collision path stays separator-bounded beneath the selected root. Traversal/rooted/ADS/invalid/device/superscript/reserved-job/trailing aliases, file blockers, an actual junction and a disappeared root reject safely. Actual jobs use validated descendants and unchanged per-directory no-clobber ownership; sentinel sources/finals remain unchanged.

Preserve mode refuses equal roots, output inside source and source inside output before native/config/output/log writes. Unit boundary guards and actual protected filesystem snapshots confirm this on both hosts, preventing self-reingestion across runs without inferring file ownership. Flat frozen-queue policy remains unchanged.

policy.roots: Contributing selected folders or explicit-file parents; deduplicate canonical Windows identities and choose shallowest covering roots; sort OrdinalIgnoreCase; multiple roots get unique reserved leaf labels, drive roots drive-D, UNC share roots share name
policy.overlap: Reject equality or containment in either direction before startup
policy.manifest: Preserve mode rejects doctor/ManifestPath/Resume/StrongSourceHash; manifests remain flat-only
policy.directories: Selected output root must already exist; preview creates none; dispatch validates and creates only descendants; vanished root is not recreated

scope_expansion: Minimal existing preview/batch/log routing, matching recorder, actual WhatIf integration fixtures and README/spec/test documentation. BAT forwarding unchanged; no new application runtime/config/TUI controls.
report_name_encoding: The existing PS5.1 parent Read-WvcChildReport uses Get-Content without an encoding, so six superscript case display names in clean Full have UTF-8-as-ANSI mojibake. They are matched with explicit aliases for those six known names only; original reports/hashes and Passed statuses are preserved. Direct final51 report retains the expected Unicode names. No application or assertion result is changed.
failures_and_corrections: Focused regression initially0 passed/1 failed; minimal implementation1/0.
Read-only safety review caught a vanished destination root being recreated and superscript COM/LPT aliases; fixed guards and added real junction/root-removal/device cases.
Read-only test review caught documented drive-root labels passing through GetFileName(D:) and becoming empty; added a pure root-label helper with uppercase/lowercase drive and UNC-share regressions.

The first real-media fixture used an empty FFREPORT value, which enables FFmpeg reports. Four task-owned diagnostics from target7/Quick were moved to ignored .test-results/m402. The corrected real-media fixture temporarily removes and restores inherited FFREPORT and omits the explicit empty child entry; corrected focused run and clean Full produce no root reports.

limitations: Full exit2/Incomplete solely eight historical manual/future NotRun rows; no milestone/release acceptance.
Preserve layout is per-run only and requires disjoint roots; flat manifest schema is intentionally retained.

Path validation assumes a stable filesystem; network/power-loss/hostile same-user substitution and broader long-path/UNC/manual gates remain unaccepted. Drive/UNC label units do not constitute actual network-share acceptance.
New empty descendants can remain after a failed job; no arbitrary folder deletion.
Preview does not prove writability/media validity/encoder success or reserve names.
Structural checks and hashes do not prove full visual/audio integrity. Earlier physical Ctrl+C, actual Explorer and owner playback remain not_run.
Intermediate reports cover evolving dirty trees without preserved tree hashes; final clean both-host Full is the acceptance authority.
Raw reports/logs/native fixtures/media/config/machine paths stay local/ignored. Private runtime bindings redacted.
